title: Introduce Rust CI bootstrap and release fastpath
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: Our presubmit and release bootstrap path currently relies on a heavy Node + Makefile flow that adds ~30s to every CI job and produces brittle caching behavior across runners. This PR replaces the fragile JS bootstrap with a tiny Rust CLI (tools/ci-bootstrap-rs) that performs deterministic toolchain installation, workspace snapshotting, and smart cache priming. The Rust tool is compiled into a single static binary used by CI images to shrink init time, reduce container layers, and centralize provenance checks.

Scope and changes (summary):
- Add tools/ci-bootstrap-rs/ (Rust tiny binary, README, Cargo.toml, integration tests)
- Replace scripts/bootstrap.sh with tools/ci-bootstrap-rs invocation in .github/workflows/ci.yml and .github/workflows/release.yml
- Remove legacy Makefile targets used only by CI (Makefile: remove ci-bootstrap, toolchain-targets)
- Add release/release-fastpath.yaml: a streamlined release job that leverages cached artifacts produced by the Rust bootstrap to produce signed release bundles on a separate workflow run
- Introduce ci/dependency-audit.toml and integrate a dependency-check step that warns on transitive vulnerabilities (non-blocking for now)
- Update docs/dev/ci.md and docs/release/fastpath.md to document behavior and rollback procedure

Checklist: 
- [x] Add Rust tool and tests
- [x] Wire into existing workflows with fallback to old bootstrap for ephemeral runners
- [x] Validate caches on Linux (x86_64) and macOS self-hosted runners
- [x] Add basic dependency auditing hook (non-blocking)
- [x] Update developer docs and release runbook

Commit summary (high level):
- feat(ci): add ci-bootstrap-rs initial scaffold and CLI args parsing
- feat(ci): implement cache priming & toolchain snapshot logic
- ci: switch workflows to invoke ci-bootstrap-rs and prune make targets
- chore(release): add release-fastpath workflow and bundle packing step
- test: add integration tests for bootstrap idempotency and cache-hit simulation
- chore(docs): update ci.md and release runbook

- .github/workflows/release.yml (add fastpath job)

Representative snippets: 
- .github/workflows/ci.yml change: "run: ./tools/ci-bootstrap-rs --workspace . --cache-key ${{ matrix.cache_key }}" 
- ci-bootstrap-rs usage example in README: "ci-bootstrap-rs --snapshot-id $(git rev-parse --short HEAD) --prime-cache"

Review discussion (abridged):
- Aleksandar: "Nice—reduces the shell footprint. Two asks: 1) keep a quick Node fallback to run older local dev flows; 2) add a debug flag that emits the exact cache key used in the workflow logs."
- Author (Maya): "Added fallback path that is only invoked when CI_FALLBACK=1; added --dump-cache-key flag and included example in docs."
- Priya: "We should ensure the release fastpath still signs artifacts in the same place and preserves provenance."
- Author: "release-fastpath uses the same signing gateway and now reuses the cached pack step; added integration asserts to verify signature metadata."
- Samir: "Dependency audit is great—please keep it non-blocking initially and open a follow-up to gate on severity=critical once we triage known items."
- Author: "Agreed, filed ENG-2201 for gating plan next quarter."

CI and verification: 
- First CI run: linux job failed with a permission issue on self-hosted mac runner (runners blocked writing to /opt/cache).
- Fix: added runner-specific tmpdir fallback and re-ran.
- Final CI: All checks passed (unit, integration, e2e smoke). Example CI summary: build (pass), unit-tests (pass), integration-smoke (pass), lint (pass), release-fastpath dry-run (pass).

Performance impact: 
- Average CI init time reduced from ~32s to ~9s on Linux runners in internal measurements (measured across 120 runs). Cache-hit simulations show end-to-end job latency improvement ~14%.

Rollback plan: 
- If failures observed in release signing or tooling, set CI_FALLBACK=1 in workflow dispatch or revert to a pinned release tag; documentation (docs/release/fastpath.md) includes the revert steps.

Merge notes: Merged with squash on 2026-01-22 after two approvals. Follow-ups: ENG-2201 (gate dependency-audit), ENG-2210 (add arm64 prebuilt bootstrap binary), PM-637 (monitor CI cost reduction and report back in Q1 retro).

- Add a release fastpath workflow that reuses cached artifacts to shorten release packaging and signing.

- Remove legacy Makefile CI targets and bootstrap shell script.
